text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I came to
the amusement park with Furioso—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Hm...? That attraction seems quite popular.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"‘Dark Terror Mystery House’?
...C-Could it be... one of those scary kinds of—"
choice_data_list: I'm terrible with horror, so maybe I shouldn't...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Head over to the other attractions...
Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: A-A-A-Alright... Let's do this! For real, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san, I reckon it'd be
best not to push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: S-Shut up! I'm not overdoing it!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
…………
I-In that case... I must go as well!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume from the Central went, but
the Umamusume from Funabashi didn't...
We cannot afford to bear such a sense of inferiority!

text_block_list.name: Ghost
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
GYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, are you all right?
Maybe you really should leave—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-I'm not scared at all, okay!?
Total piece of ca—...hm?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaaaah!?!?
Furioso!? What the hell do you think you're doing!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufu... I wanted to test
the courage of Central's Umamusume.
So I dressed up as a ghost and—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Cut the crap, you were just frozen stiff with fear, weren't ya!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: N-No, that's not it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so... willy-nilly, a horror endurance battle between Funabashi Umamusume and Central Umamusume began!

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: Uuuuuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuwaaaahhh...!
T-This isn't me being scared,
it's a groan from sudden stomach pain...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
......!
This is... the pose of someone turning into a zombie while frozen in agonizing pain...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't bunch up in the narrow hallway! Keep moving, go, go!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, the Central Umamusume is holding out pretty well.
In this contest, whoever flinches first... loses!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: !? W-W-W-W-Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Eerie Voice
text_block_list.text: —P-Plea... se...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaaaaat?!?!?
Seriously, what is that?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: S-something is... coming...!

text_block_list.name: Ghost
text_block_list.text: H-Help... me...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Man, that last bit really took me by surprise.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: W-W-Well... Personally, I wouldn't have minded if it were even scarier.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Still, who would've thought even Furioso
would keep a straight face through that...
H-Hmph! Acting all cool and collected!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Phaaah! Haa, haa...!
I-I managed... not to make a fool of myself.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: It's all about reversing your thinking. Whenever I get scared by ghosts, I inevitably freeze up. So instead—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Just before fear strikes. Keeping an unfazed expression—
and deliberately freezing "on my own"!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Freezing in a specific pose has always been my special skill...
And that skill paid off.
choice_data_list: As long as you have that, any horror should be fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes. At least, letting fear show on the surface—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's impossible.
It's utterly impossible...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's true that... I was almost beaten by Espo-san's
ability to 'scream at the top of her lungs and make me terrified too,'
but—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I will work even harder so that not only my outward appearance, but my inner heart remains solid in a calm 'pose.'
